executable_reason: a multi-stage plan cannot run in one process: it needs activation transport between workers (Phase 6: run it with `execute --remote`, one worker process per stage, or emulate it locally)
warnings: Inter-stage transfer time is NOT modelled (no link bandwidth given); real pipelines pay it per boundary.
rehearsal-a shares host 'YakobsPC' with 1 other worker(s); each is given 1/2 of its usable RAM. Local processes on one machine are NOT independent computers.
rehearsal-b shares host 'YakobsPC' with 1 other worker(s); each is given 1/2 of its usable RAM. Local processes on one machine are NOT independent computers.

rehearsal-a is this planning machine (YakobsPC): its available RAM was measured while this planner process (~700 MiB, mostly torch + transformers) was running, so it is lower than a worker would see without the planner.

rehearsal-b is this planning machine (YakobsPC): its available RAM was measured while this planner process (~700 MiB, mostly torch + transformers) was running, so it is lower than a worker would see without the planner.
assumptions: Stage time = calculated FLOPs / effective throughput; elementwise ops and memory-bandwidth limits are not modelled.
Memory covers a worst-case prefill of prompt_length tokens with a KV cache sized for context_length.
Activations assume eager attention (scores materialized) and are freed layer by layer.
The first stage holds the embeddings, the last stage the final norm and LM head (layer order is fixed).
